title: A Wave From It All | KEY.co
description_expanded: The heart of this home is its open-concept layout, perfect for hosting large gatherings or intimate moments alike, bathed in natural light from the picturesque windows. Culinary enthusiasts will revel in the fully equipped kitchen, adorned with stainless steel appliances and quartz countertops, while the spacious dining area and cozy living room promise memorable meals and relaxation. The outdoor private patio with a grill offers an additional slice of paradise, where you can savor alfresco dining or simply unwind. The addition of a golf cart makes exploring the beauty of 30A effortless, inviting you to indulge in the sugar-white sands or the lush trails leading into Point Washington State Park. A Wave From It All is more than a vacation rental—it's a gateway to luxurious beachside living, where every detail contributes to an unforgettable escape. Immerse yourself in the seamless blend of elegance and coastal charm at A Wave From It All, a stunning cottage nestled in the serene Cassine Village. This haven boasts three beautifully appointed bedrooms, two luxurious baths, and a delightful fenced backyard, creating an idyllic setting for both relaxation and entertainment. Its prime location not only offers direct access to the shimmering community pools just steps away but also positions you a leisurely stroll from the pristine beachfront. The cottage's design, reminiscent of a feature on HGTV, showcases sophisticated décor, soothing beach tones, and rustic fixtures, all harmonizing to craft an atmosphere of refined beachside living.
